name: Tapetes São José

typography.pairing_note: A single humanist sans (Plus Jakarta Sans) across weights — calm and modern, letting the earthy palette and product photography lead.

layout: Warm neutral canvas with slate text, terracotta primary and olive accent; a configurator ('crie seu tapete'); room-scene photography; consultation CTA.
notes: Made-to-measure rugs: earthy terracotta (#a26127) + olive (#8d8664) + cream (#e8e3de) on slate (#343141) — warm, artisanal, homely.
